statement: A tertiary progression symbolically advances the birth chart by one day for each sidereal month (about 27.3 days) of life — roughly twelve times faster than a secondary progression's one day per year. It reads as a fast, month-by-month unfolding, prized for timing the specific month of a shift that a secondary progression only marks in broad, year-scale strokes.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
